object.description: In a repository of PARENT and CHILD, where neither document has a validation error, call validate_document for PARENT. Then define on CHILD a required text attribute rationale, which CHILD's one object CHILD-0 doesn't set, and call validate_document for CHILD. Expected: for PARENT, ok true and no errors; for CHILD, ok false and an error with the code ATTR_MISSING_REQUIRED whose message names CHILD-0, each error holding a code and a message.
